title: Paying Ahead on a Pending Medical Assistance Application — Coming Month's Estimated Patient Pay
content:
While an application is pending, a resident or representative may pay toward the coming month's estimated patient pay; the payment is posted as a patient pay payment by ACH that names no charge, and it is applied, oldest service month first, when the coming month's estimate is billed. This page of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage concerns that payment on a case whose application is pending.

**When the advance is worked out.**

> The advance toward a coming pending month is worked out only after the estimate of the last closed month stands at no more than that month's cost of care.

That is, the advance waits on the case's records showing the last closed month's estimate at or below that month's cost of care.

**The estimate behind the advance.** For an advance toward a coming pending month, and only for such an advance, the estimated patient pay is figured under the rule for such advances; every estimate the business office bills remains under the base rule: gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less health insurance premiums the resident pays, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance on the worksheet when the tier applies it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## The payment tool

**Capability.** `pay_pending_patient_pay_advance_fe3c809e` sends a payment by ACH toward the coming month's patient pay on a Medical Assistance case whose application is pending: the resident or representative pays now for a month whose charge does not exist on the record. The payment is recorded on the case's billing record as a patient pay payment by ACH that is applied to no charge, and the case's patient pay balance falls by the amount paid. The payer sees a confirmation number and the new balance.

**Invocation.** This is a customer-run tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**
- `medicaid_case_id` — the reference number of the resident's Medical Assistance case the payment is made on, as the business office gives it to the payer from the case record (identifier).
- `amount` — the payment in US dollars: a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator.

**Return.** Complete when the receipt comes back with status received. Fields: `confirmation_number` (reference number of the payment entry), `medicaid_case_id`, `payment_method` (always ACH), `amount` (two decimals), `entry_date` (date received, YYYY-MM-DD), `applied_to_charge` (empty, since the payment names no charge), `patient_pay_balance` (two decimals with the payment posted; a leading minus sign means a credit) and status. An amount that is not a positive figure is refused with an error and nothing is recorded.
